selectorCaveat: The selector is recorded for provenance only. The AUTHORITY is the id list below and its hash — re-deriving from created_at is correct only while one lane is the sole writer for that day.
idsHashAlgorithm: sha256 over the ids sorted ascending, newline-joined

scriptQuality.note: script-quality-cli.ts writes exactly ONE verdict, legacy_font_ascii, and leaves the rest NULL on purpose: `clean` would have to be asserted from the ABSENCE of a signal, and a pure-ASCII English judgment is byte-identical to a Hindi one whose Devanagari the extractor deleted. A NULL here therefore means NOT ASSESSED, never assessed-and-fine. Anything reading it as a pass is admitting on absence of evidence.
